name: Workspace Identity
description: Define and implement a stable, unique workspace identity system. Identity must survive rename, move, and clone operations without changing. Identity is the root anchor for all workspace state — repository attachments, artifact provenance, session history, and cross-workspace references all depend on a stable identity.
purpose: Every workspace must have a single, durable identity that persists across filesystem operations. Without stable identity, repository attachments break on rename, artifact provenance chains break on move, and cross-workspace references become impossible to maintain.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace identity is a UUIDv7 that never changes after creation
Rename of workspace directory does not change identity
Move of workspace directory does not change identity
Clone of a workspace creates a new workspace with a new identity
Identity is stored in a well-known location within the workspace
Identity survives filesystem-level copy operations (identity stays with original, copy gets new)
All workspace state records reference identity as the foreign key
Identity collision detection and recovery on clone or copy
